intro.t: Your partner has a good idea. Take it, add something, and keep it going. That's what the examiner wants to hear in Part 3.

close.t: Great teamwork. Take the idea, add to it, pass it back.

reels.note: The simplest way to build on what you heard.

ex.t: Yes, and {another thing is} that you can watch them on the bus.
ex.q: Using apps and videos is great for revision.

ex.t: {Another thing is} that you learn to work under pressure.
ex.q: Working in a café teaches you to talk to people.

ex.t: {Another thing is} that everyone can play, even grandparents.
ex.q: Playing games at home is cheap and fun.

reels.note: Short, light, and it keeps the ball moving.

ex.t: {It could also} stop you leaving everything until the last minute.
ex.q: A study timetable helps you organise your time.

ex.t: {It could also} help you decide if you'd like to be a teacher.
ex.q: Giving lessons to younger children is a good job.

ex.t: {It could also} help students make new friends.
ex.q: An after-school sports club is a good idea.

ex.t: {On top of that,} students would learn better eating habits.
ex.q: Healthier school meals would give students more energy.

ex.t: {On top of that,} they usually have amazing stories to tell.
ex.q: Visiting grandparents makes them really happy.

ex.t: {On top of that,} it's cheaper than paying for petrol.
ex.q: Using public transport is better for the planet.

reels.note: Slightly more formal than "On top of that".

ex.t: {What's more,} you meet people who care about the same things.
ex.q: Joining a beach clean-up is a great idea.

ex.t: {What's more,} it's free, even if your friends live abroad.
ex.q: Keeping in touch with friends online is really useful.

ex.t: {What's more,} it gets everyone off their phones for a while.
ex.q: Doing sport together is good for families.

reels.p: Yes, I agree. Another thing to consider is …
reels.bt: Yes, I agree. Another thing to consider is…
reels.note: The whole move in one line.

ex.t: {Yes, I agree. Another thing to consider is} that tired students forget what they've learned.
ex.q: Getting enough sleep is really important before exams.

ex.t: {Yes, I agree. Another thing to consider is} how much water it takes to make them.
{Yes, I agree. Another thing to consider is} whether the information is true.
ex.q: Finding information online is really fast.

reels.p: I hadn't thought of that. I suppose it could also …
reels.bt: I hadn't thought of that. I suppose it could also…
reels.note: Sounds like a real conversation, not a script.

ex.t: {I hadn't thought of that. I suppose it could also} be a bit stressful.
ex.q: Helping in a family business teaches you responsibility.

ex.t: {I hadn't thought of that. I suppose it could also} help you build a portfolio.
ex.q: Being creative online can lead to a career.

ex.t: {I hadn't thought of that. I suppose it could also} help people sleep better.
ex.q: More PE lessons could reduce stress.
